ModMetaData.name: RimMandrake: RSW — Beast Lairs
ModMetaData.author: mandrake
ModMetaData.description:
`RSW_BeastNest_Large` — a 3x3 scenery prop filed against `structure_procedural_spec.md` section 9: no large-nest ThingDef existed in the 593-mod stack, so a lair archetype had to fake the den with bare terrain and a hay stack. Modeled on the shape of the stack's existing nest scenery (`EggSac` [Odyssey], `MA_HarpeagleNest` [Mythic Ages], `MaggotNest` [Horrors]) — a claimable=false, non-buildable (no `designationCategory`) Building scattered by map generation, not the player — but with every pawn-spawning comp those three carry stripped out: this is dressing for a lair whatever occupies it is spawned separately, never a spawner in its own right. It carries vanilla's own `CompSpawnerFilth` (used by `Hive`) set to `Filth_AnimalFilth`, firing once at `PostSpawnSetup` so the nest scatters its own mess the moment it is placed.
RimStarWars tier (world/planet fauna, not campaign-specific) per `NAMING_SCHEME_PLAN.md`.
